svg.title: Parameters: How the Model Generates
svg.desc: Four parameters shape how the model generates its reply. Temperature or top_p: lower temperature is more focused and deterministic; change one, not both. Max tokens: too low cuts replies off. frequency_penalty cuts repetition. presence_penalty pushes new topics. Reasoning models in the GPT-5 series don't accept temperature, top_p or the penalties. HTTP 429 is a rate limit, not a parameter problem: raise TPM within quota, or cut max tokens and concurrency.
svg.text: Each parameter turns one dial on the reply; reasoning models don't accept most of them.
Don't accept temperature, top_p or the penalties
HTTP 429 = rate limit, not a parameter
Raise TPM within quota, or cut max tokens and concurrency
